BioCare Limited.note: BioCare Limited was acquired by Chinese-funded enterprise Sinolife United in November 2014.

Carlson Laboratories.note: Carlson Laboratories operates under J.R. Carlson Laboratories, Inc. as a family-owned and women-led company.

Doctors Naturals.note: Doctors Naturals operates as a dietary supplement brand owned and manufactured under Doctors Pharma in Saudi Arabia.

Goli Nutrition Inc..note: Goli Nutrition Inc. was acquired in 2024 by a business consortium consisting of Group KPS, Bastion Capital, and one of its original founders to avoid bankruptcy.

J.R. Carlson Laboratories, Inc..note: J.R. Carlson Laboratories, Inc. remains an independent family-owned and women-led company since its founding in 1965.

MRO MaryRuth, LLC.note: Founder MaryRuth Ghiyam and her family retain majority ownership of the business after private equity firm Butterfly exited most of its stake in 2024.

Natural Organics, Inc..note: Natural Organics, Inc., manufacturer of the NaturesPlus brand, continues to operate as an independent, privately held company.

Nestle Health Science.note: Nestle Health Science operates as a major strategic business unit and acquirer within the global wellness sector rather than being acquired.

NutraBio Labs, Inc..note: NutraBio Labs, Inc. continues to operate independently and expanded its own portfolio by acquiring Kinara Inc. in 2024.

Organico.note: There is no verifiable record of any acquisition, majority-stake purchase, merger, or asset purchase involving the company, which continues to operate its direct-to-consumer e-commerce supplement brand in Egypt.

Pure Encapsulations.note: Nestlé acquired Atrium Innovations, the parent company of Pure Encapsulations, in 2017.

Sehatech.note: Sehatech (sehatech.co) is a Saudi-based nutritional supplements company that remains independently owned and operating without any recorded history of acquisition.

Swanson.note: Swander Pace Capital acquired Swanson Health Products in January 2016.

Vitamaze GmbH.note: Vision Healthcare acquired 100% of the shares in Vitamaze GmbH in November 2021.
